title: Shinonome Ena — What Wounds Can't Break〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think I finally know what to draw for my art class assignment...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Tranquility...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To me, that's...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, shall we get our after-party started?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
I didn't do any work this time around, so I'll do my best to make sure everyone has a fun time♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I get that you're excited, but would you mind not shouting like that when I'm sitting right next to you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, we might get thrown out for being too loud.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't worry! I'll be careful on that front!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honestly... Oh, these pancakes look really good. But so do the ones on this page.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You said you wanted to have some pancakes today, right, Mizuki? Let's order different ones and share them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, mind if I top mine with some chocolate?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure. I think I'll get some toppings too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think I'll get... The curry udon.
What about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The vongole bianco.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, what's that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Clam pasta.
Still, Mafuyu, I feel like you've been ordering pasta a lot during our recent after-parties.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I've been going in order from the top left of the menu...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You have? Even if you can't really taste anything, you could be a little more selective...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, cut her some slack. This is huge progress considering she used to always order the same thing as someone else!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, it's shopping time.
Where do you wanna go first?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To go buy the new Forte la Zeal release, of course!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: After that, we can browse around the mall and... Oh, wanna check out that cafe? They had their grand reopening, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The one with the pudding?
You remembered?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I mean, you're the one who sent me those messages on Nightcord reminding me how they were almost finished doing those renovations.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But it's kinda far from here.
Let's see how we're feeling once we've finished doing our shopping?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's like less than a ten-minute walk. You'll be fine♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that I'm the indoorsy type.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Plus, we don't absolutely have to go to that cafe today. It's not like it's going anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good point...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's go over to the cosmetics department to grab that new release!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Eating, drinking and talking about stupid stuff during after-parties. Shopping until we literally drop...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The things we always do. Nothing out of the ordinary.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Getting to talk to Mizuki and us staying friends...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's what I want.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's what puts me at ease.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I know what to draw now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's get started!
